DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The improvement in cyanosis with oxygen administration suggests a respiratory etiology rather than a systemic infection like a urinary tract infection, which would not typically present primarily as respiratory distress in a newborn. To confirm the diagnosis, I will need to see chest X-rays and review the results of the requested Apgar score and maternal history tests.
